Welcome to Kananga Special Tented Camp
Kananga Special Tented Camp is a very comfortable and reasonably priced tented camp at Seronera, in the heart of the Serengeti National Park. Hidden in an enclave, surrounded by spectacular views and abundant wildlife, our special tented camp sits at the foot of the Banagi hills, overlooking a beautiful savannah resplendent with the emblematic East African Thorn trees.

About us
Kananga is a Spanish Tour operator specialising in adventure travel throughout the African continent since 1992. As the pioneers in the Spanish Market to offer overland safaris, today it is proud to design and operate more than 55 itineraries in over 30 African countries, all of which are controlled 100% by Kananga head office in Barcelona.
Its African branch, based in Arusha, Tanzania, runs two tented camps inside the most emblematic National Parks in East Africa; Julia s River Camp within the Masai Mara Nature Reserve in Kenya and Kananga Special Tented Camp inside the Serengeti National Park. It also operates its own logistical base; with a fleet of 22 specially adapted overland trucks for the best safari experience.

Mess Tents Kananga Special Tented Camp
Kananga Special Tented Camp
Mess Tents
Watching the zebras crossing Banagi Plain at sunset while sipping a cold glass of South African wine, enjoying a delicious three-course dinner to the sounds of the African night or sitting back in our comfortable sofas and relaxing after an exciting day’s safari are even more enjoyable in our new spacious Mess Tents.
Each Mess Tent is unique to that particular camp; i.e. guests staying in our Classic Camp will share this communal area with 10 other Classic Tents and our VIP guests with a maximum of 5 other VIP tents. All Mess Tents offer a dining area where our friendly staff will be happy to cater for your every need, as well as a chill-out area where you can peruse our small library, recharge cameras, mobile phones or laptops and enjoy our bar service whilst you soak up the spectacular atmosphere. And, to add the finishing touch to your evening before turning in for the night, perhaps we can tempt you with a digestif and some friendly chat around the campfire whilst admiring the sparkling african skies.

How to get to us:
Situated at the foot of the Banagi hills, we can easily be reached by road or air. From the Seronera air strip, head in the direction of Lobo. Once across the bridge you will come to a fork in the road (Ndabaka and Lobo), take the Lobo road and continue straight for 5.8 kms (about 10-15 minutes). When you see a road with stones on your left, turn left and continue for 2.3 kms until you reach the camp.
